lead.titleZh: 老年全膝置换术中无阿片类麻醉对术后免疫功能影响的RCT
lead.titleEn: RCT on Opioid-Free Anesthesia's Impact on Post-TKA Immune Function in Elderly
lead.paragraphZh: 今日日报共9条，涵盖6个专业方向。其中，有2条 curatedScore 达到75分。最高分的RCT提示，老年全膝关节置换术中无阿片类麻醉对术后免疫功能有积极影响，值得关注。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's report features 9 entries across 6 specialties, with 2 curatedScore entries reaching 75. The top-scoring RCT indicates that opioid-free anesthesia during total knee arthroplasty positively impacts postoperative immune function in elderly patients, warranting attention.

items.title: Effects of opioid-free intraoperative anesthesia versus opioid-based anesthesia on postoperative immune function in elderly patients undergoing total knee arthroplasty: a single-center, prospective, randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A single-center, prospective, randomized controlled trial investigates the effects of opioid-free intraoperative anesthesia versus opioid-based anesthesia on postoperative immune function in elderly patients undergoing total knee arthroplasty.
items.curatedReason: 对于全膝关节置换术的老年患者，无阿片类麻醉可能带来术后免疫功能改善的益处。在考虑术后康复方案时，应将这种麻醉选择对患者恢复的影响纳入考量。
items.titleZh: 老年全膝关节置换术中无阿片类麻醉对术后免疫功能影响的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单中心、前瞻性随机对照试验旨在比较老年全膝关节置换术中，无阿片类麻醉与阿片类麻醉对患者术后免疫功能的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Opioid-free anesthesia in elderly patients undergoing total knee arthroplasty may offer benefits in postoperative immune function. You should consider the impact of this anesthetic choice on patient recovery when planning postoperative rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 研究仅关注术后免疫功能，未报告直接的临床康复结局。
items.limitationEn: The study focused solely on postoperative immune function, without reporting direct clinical rehabilitation outcomes.

items.title: Surgical approaches for screw fixation of calcaneal fractures: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review summarizes evidence on different screw configurations for internal fixation of calcaneal fractures, identifying relevant studies from major databases up to December 2025.
items.curatedReason: 这份系统综述虽然聚焦跟骨骨折的手术固定方式，但仍有助你理解不同螺钉配置如何影响术后负重和康复进展的生物力学考量。在制定康复计划时，应向外科医生确认具体的固定情况。
items.titleZh: 跟骨骨折螺钉固定手术入路的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述总结了跟骨骨折内固定治疗中不同螺钉配置的证据，旨在为外科医生选择最佳方案提供参考。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review evaluates different screw fixation configurations for calcaneal fractures. While it focuses on surgical techniques, it can help you understand the biomechanical basis for postoperative weight-bearing restrictions and rehabilitation progression.
items.limitation: 该综述主要关注外科手术的比较，未直接涉及康复干预的结局。
items.limitationEn: The review primarily focuses on comparing surgical approaches and does not directly address rehabilitation intervention outcomes.

items.title: Integrated rehabilitation incorporating aquatic therapy following posterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: a case report.
items.summary: A case report of a 51-year-old woman showed that integrated rehabilitation incorporating aquatic therapy following PCL reconstruction helped facilitate early functional recovery and reduced joint loading.
items.curatedReason: PCL 重建术后水疗的证据仍然稀缺。本病例报告提示水疗在早期功能恢复中可能发挥作用，但别把它当成常规方案。
items.titleZh: 整合水疗的后交叉韧带重建术后康复：一例病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一例 51 岁女性的病例报告显示，后交叉韧带（PCL）重建术后整合水疗的康复方案有助于促进早期功能恢复并减轻关节负荷。
items.curatedReasonEn: Evidence for aquatic therapy after PCL reconstruction remains scarce. This case report suggests aquatic therapy may facilitate early functional recovery, but don't integrate it into routine protocols yet.
items.limitation: 本研究为单病例报告，证据等级低，结果外推性差。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report with a low level of evidence and limited generalizability.

items.title: From Injury to Inclusion: Evidence From the International Spinal Cord Injury Survey (InSCI).
items.summary: An evidence map of the International Spinal Cord Injury Community Survey (InSCI) identified 117 peer-reviewed publications by April 2026, with healthcare needs and epidemiology being the largest categories, indicating significant research contributions and remaining knowledge gaps.
items.curatedReason: InSCI 问卷的证据图谱让你对全球脊髓损伤（SCI）研究的广度、焦点和知识缺口有清晰认识。可利用它快速定位你感兴趣的 SCI 亚专业方向，避免重复工作。
items.titleZh: 从损伤到融合：国际脊髓损伤调查（InSCI）的证据
items.summaryZh: 国际脊髓损伤社区调查（InSCI）的证据图谱显示，截至 2026 年 4 月，已产生 117 篇同行评议论文，其中医疗需求和流行病学是最大的类别，表明其显著的研究贡献和尚存的知识缺口。
items.curatedReasonEn: This InSCI evidence map, covering 117 peer-reviewed publications by April 2026, highlights that research is heavily concentrated on healthcare needs and epidemiology. If you're involved in spinal cord injury (SCI) research, use this map to quickly grasp current foci and identify under-researched areas, streamlining your efforts.
items.limitation: 证据图谱本身是对现有文献的汇总分析，不提供新的临床干预效果证据。
items.limitationEn: The evidence map itself is a summary analysis of existing literature and does not provide new evidence on the effects of clinical interventions.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Situational characteristics of lower limb muscle cramps in male semi-elite football players: a video-based descriptive case series
items.summary: A video-based descriptive case series investigates the situational characteristics of lower limb muscle cramps in male semi-elite football players.
items.curatedReason: 半精英足球运动员的下肢肌肉痉挛，往往有其特定的发生情境。在评估和制定预防策略时，你需要更细致地询问痉挛的具体诱因和发生环境，因为这些细节可能比通用方案更有效。
items.titleZh: 半精英男足运动员下肢肌肉痉挛情境特征的视频描述性病例系列研究
items.summaryZh: 这项基于视频的描述性病例系列研究调查了半精英男性足球运动员下肢肌肉痉挛的情境特征。
items.curatedReasonEn: Lower limb muscle cramps in semi-elite football players often have specific situational characteristics. When assessing and developing prevention strategies, you need to inquire more precisely about the specific triggers and contexts of cramps, as these details may be more effective than general approaches.
items.limitation: 描述性研究，样本量小且局限于半精英男性足球运动员，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a descriptive study with a small sample size, limited to semi-elite male football players, thus limiting generalizability.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Differential neuromuscular adaptations following multi-joint vs single-joint resistance exercise training
items.summary: This study combines ultrasound, EMG, and dynamometry to establish differences in neuromechanical adaptations following multi-joint (squat) versus single-joint resistance training programs of equal training volume in 24 participants.
items.curatedReason: 多关节与单关节抗阻训练对神经肌肉适应性确实存在差异。在为患者设计抗阻训练时，不要仅仅关注训练量，更要根据运动特异性来选择多关节或单关节训练，以优化力量发展和功能恢复。
items.titleZh: 多关节与单关节抗阻训练对神经肌肉适应性的差异影响
items.summaryZh: 这项研究结合超声、肌电图和测力学测量，旨在评估多关节（深蹲）与单关节抗阻训练在神经肌肉适应性上的差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Multi-joint and single-joint resistance training indeed lead to different neuromuscular adaptations. When designing resistance training for patients, don't just focus on training volume; instead, choose multi-joint or single-joint exercises based on movement specificity to optimize strength development and functional recovery.
items.limitation: 研究细节不详，无法评估样本量和具体干预方案的严谨性。
items.limitationEn: Study details are insufficient to assess the rigor of sample size and specific intervention protocols.

items.title: Arthroscopic-assisted uni-portal spinal surgery versus unilateral biportal endoscopy for lumbar degenerative diseases: a systematic review and meta-analysis of clinical outcomes and complications
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis compares the clinical outcomes and complications of arthroscopic-assisted uni-portal spinal surgery versus unilateral biportal endoscopy for lumbar degenerative diseases.
items.curatedReason: 这份系统综述比较了两种微创脊柱内镜手术（关节镜辅助单通道与单侧双通道）在腰椎退行性疾病中的临床效果和并发症。尽管是外科内容，但这些手术选择直接影响患者术后康复路径和PT介入时机。
items.titleZh: 关节镜辅助单通道与单侧双通道脊柱内镜手术治疗腰椎退行性疾病的系统综述和Meta分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和Meta分析比较了关节镜辅助单通道脊柱手术与单侧双通道内镜手术治疗腰椎退行性疾病的临床结局和并发症。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review compares two minimally invasive endoscopic spinal surgeries (arthroscopic-assisted uni-portal vs. unilateral biportal) for lumbar degenerative diseases in terms of clinical outcomes and complications. Although surgical, these choices directly impact patients' postoperative rehabilitation pathways and PT intervention timing.
items.limitation: 该综述聚焦外科手术方法的比较，未直接分析不同术式对康复结局的具体影响。
items.limitationEn: The review focuses on comparing surgical methods and does not directly analyze the specific impact of different techniques on rehabilitation outcomes.

items.title: Associations between patient quality of life and caregiver burden among older adults receiving comprehensive geriatric assessment via telemedicine: a cross-sectional study from Seha Virtual Hospital, Saudi Arabia
items.summary: A cross-sectional study from Saudi Arabia explores associations between patient quality of life and caregiver burden among older adults receiving comprehensive geriatric assessment via telemedicine.
items.curatedReason: 远程医疗模式下，老年患者的生活质量与照护者负担之间存在显著关联。作为物理治疗师，你在远程康复中不仅要关注患者本身，也应主动识别和支持照护者，因为他们的负担会直接影响患者的康复依从性和效果。
items.titleZh: 沙特阿拉伯远程医疗综合老年评估中老年患者生活质量与照护者负担的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项来自沙特阿拉伯Seha虚拟医院的横断面研究，探讨了通过远程医疗接受综合老年评估的老年患者生活质量与照护者负担之间的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: In telemedicine, there's a significant link between older patients' quality of life and caregiver burden. As a PT, in telerehabilitation, you must not only focus on the patient but also proactively identify and support caregivers, as their burden directly impacts patient adherence and rehabilitation outcomes.
items.limitation: 横断面研究无法建立因果关系，且研究人群和背景局限于沙特阿拉伯的虚拟医院，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study cannot establish causality, and its population and context are limited to a virtual hospital in Saudi Arabia, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Ahpra appoints new head of its Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Strategy Unit
items.summary: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (Ahpra) has announced the appointment of a new head for its Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Strategy Unit.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构（Ahpra）任命了新的原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民健康战略部门负责人。虽然是行政任命，但此类举措可能预示着未来在文化安全医疗和多元化执业方面会有更多政策倾斜，对你在澳大利亚的执业环境有潜在影响。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构任命原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民健康战略部门新负责人
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构（Ahpra）宣布任命原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民健康战略部门的新负责人。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (Ahpra) has appointed a new head for its Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Strategy Unit. While an administrative appointment, such moves may signal future policy emphasis on culturally safe healthcare and diverse practice, potentially impacting your practice environment in Australia.
